What It Does for a Round Face: Parks the visual weight on the chin while the cheeks stay bare so the eye travels down instead of sideways
Length Band: Chin patch tight with the point carrying the length - cutmuse's round-face barber script puts chin growth at one inch
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: Modern form connects the mustache to the chin patch - the tip stays pointed because a rounded tip loses the elongating effect
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: No cheek growth - cheeks clean-shaven or very short

What It Does for a Round Face: Stretches the goatee along the jaw into a central column of hair that marks the lower jaw and slims the face without touching the cheeks
Length Band: A step fuller than the classic goatee - just enough coverage to trace the jawline
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: Mustache connects through to the chin and out along the jaw - cheek lines stay crisp and tapered because flared cheek lines cancel the slimming
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: The jawline strip replaces sideburn mass - the strong pick when cheeks grow patchy

What It Does for a Round Face: Traces the jawline and narrows into a pointed chin patch - the outline draws a sharper jaw onto a face that lacks one
Length Band: Grown to a base length first then sculpted - grow / shave cheeks and neck / outline the anchor along the jaw / detail the mustache
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: A thin line connects the pointed chin patch to the lower lip with the mustache and a soul patch completing the anchor shape
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: Cheeks shaved clean around the outline - the sharp lines need a steady hand or a barber

What It Does for a Round Face: A pointed chin beard with a detached mustache - the point stretches the lower half of the face
Length Band: Chin section pointed rather than rounded
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: The mustache and the chin beard are deliberately kept separate - the disconnect is the design
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: Cheeks completely clean - a small amount of mustache wax keeps the two pieces tidy

What It Does for a Round Face: Three disconnected pieces - floating mustache / soul patch / chin beard - stack the structure at the centre of the face
Length Band: Chin section slightly fuller than the Van Dyke's
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: An angled shave along the cheekbones completes the shape - the mustache floats free of the chin patch
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: No sideburns - clean cheeks let the chin carry the visual weight

What It Does for a Round Face: Squares off the jaw corners while the chin stays longer than the sides pulling the face downward instead of outward
Length Band: 3-6 mm on the cheeks with 8-25 mm at the chin (beardguru) / about a quarter to half an inch all around (cutmuse)
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: Cheek lines low and straight tapering toward the chin for a V-effect - the jaw corners are squared never rounded
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: Sideburns short and compressed because puffy sideburns push the face outward - blending into the tapered sides

What It Does for a Round Face: A full beard kept shorter on the sides tapering to a point below the chin - vertical length without giving up full coverage
Length Band: Two bands - a short ducktail that stays cleaner and office-friendly or a longer ducktail that leans rugged and dramatic
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: A neat shaped mustache - the sides stay close to the skin so no width lands at the cheeks
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: Sides trimmed tidy - needs thick beard hair to hold the point cleanly

What It Does for a Round Face: Shadow and texture slim the cheeks with the least commitment - but only while the lines stay crisp
Length Band: 1-3 mm for even five o'clock shadow (beardgains / cutmuse) / 3-5 mm (gentinspire) / 5-7 mm for the heavy version (hairsworld)
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: The chin area sits slightly longer than the cheeks for vertical contrast - the guides split on the cheek line itself (beardbeasts high and sharp / hairsworld low along the jaw)
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: Sideburns faded into the stubble rather than left thick - refreshing the fade every few days holds the shape

What It Does for a Round Face: The one full-beard form the round-face guides endorse - length below the jaw with the sides tapered tight so the width never lands at the cheeks
Length Band: 25-50 mm (beardguru) / trimmed to 1-1.5 inches with the chin kept under 2 inches (cutmuse)
Mustache & Beard Line Placement: The cheek line follows where the beard naturally thins - a hard geometric line carved above it reads drawn-on
Sideburns or Neckline Pairing: A tapered fade runs from the sideburns into the beard rather than a hard block and the sideburns are trimmed to avoid puffiness
